observations.detail: pass; expected: exactly one commit and one ErrLimit; actual: committed=1; ErrLimit=1; other_errors=0; authorized=3; command: barrier release two goroutines: ObserveAndAuthorize(real NetBirdAdapter); read committed rows

observations.name: loser authorization readback

observations.name: revoke releases exactly one slot
observations.detail: pass; expected: 202; 3 to 2 to 3; former loser admitted; actual: revoke_HTTP=202; after_revoke=2; admitted=true; final_authorized=3; command: DELETE A2 through member API; ObserveAndAuthorize former loser

observations.name: admission counters
observations.detail: pass; expected: record actual per-device counters; actual: read_ok=true; counters=0; command: docker exec node nft -j list table inet fvpn

observations.name: mTLS usage binding negative control
observations.detail: pass; expected: binding_not_found; no made-up binding accepted; actual: HTTP=200; per_event_results=1; binding_not_found=true; command: POST /agent/usage-batches with real node mTLS and explicitly unknown device

observations.name: real projected binding usage replay
observations.detail: pass; expected: accepted then duplicate; one receipt and sample; actual: first=accepted; replay=duplicate; sequence=1; device_revision=1; command: POST node-mTLS synthetic usage for real projected binding, interval inside [valid_from,valid_until), twice

observations.name: positive control durable evidence
observations.detail: pass; expected: one receipt, one sample; actual: receipts=1; samples=1; command: SELECT usage_events and usage_samples after duplicate

observations.name: post-worker projection readback
observations.detail: pass; expected: record native proofs, devices and desired/applied separately; actual: verified_proofs=11; authorized_devices=4; observed_authorized=4; desired_generation=31; applied_generation=31; command: read product projections after worker resumes; no projection fixtures
